goal: Wave 3 build: Pin the skill versions a run used; Slash templates and presets as authored kinds; Export route with JSON and Markdown renderers NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. Typecheck the frontend with node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit (tsconfig.json checks nothing). NOTE: every new switch defaults off; never flip one. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: a change to a platform prompt or a tool definition must regenerate apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-contracts/tests/fixtures/prompt-tool-manifest.json (MP_UPDATE_PROMPT_MANIFEST=1 cargo test -p mp-contracts --test prompt_tool_manifest) and add or update an eval case or replay cassette (scenario-touch gate). NOTE: Wave 3 is built in wave mode: build the code and its tests, log depth findings, no live stack and no docker (the lead runs docker). Live proofs go to the depth phase. NOTE: code first (owner order 2026-11-03): write the code and the unit tests the row names, do not run them; one guard agent compiles after the batch. session-core migrations: numbers must apply IN ORDER, so always take the next number above the highest file in the migrations folder (0107 exists; 0106 is reserved for EP-12-S14), never a lower reserved round-B number; capability-core the next free at or above 0036. Never add zdr-posture-matrix rows for a feature refusal (rows are keyed on bearers and route only); use zdr_features.rs, the feature table and docs/ZDR.md. pytest and python-pptx are not installed. action-registry.test.ts P-SPA1 is main's pre-existing failure. Error bodies keep {error:{code,message,details}} with details an object. auth-core has ONE ApiKeyExchangeController serving every audience (merged from main 2026-11-04): extend it, never add a second exchange route.

slices.title: Pin the skill versions a run used
slices.summary: Adds gateway Skill version=7/digest=8 and runs.proto SkillPin plus RunContextStatus.skills=4, content-free status_json skills, builtin pins from the embedded hash, and pin recording on the Ask and Do paths via record_status. Recovery (tool_loop reattach) reads the pinned version through GetAgentSkillVersion, with 'gone' mapped to the existing not-available text. chat_turn_registry carries id@version so feedback names the version. Optional part (b): orchestrator-core migration 0003_feedback_skill_version re-keys ratings and quarantine by version behind FEEDBACK_SKILL_VERSIONS. S3 lands before EP-7 S3/S4 on sse.rs.
slices.remaining: Depends on S2 and thus on D2/D10 acceptance. D3 (pin semantics, option a) can proceed on the recommendation. Part (b) (version-keyed feedback, orchestrator-core 0003) is optional and may be split. [Decisions taken 2026-11-04 at the recommended option (owner).]

cd "apps/Model Plane" && buf lint && buf breaking --against proto/baseline.binpb

slices.title: Slash templates and presets as authored kinds
slices.summary: Session-core migration 0098_authored_behaviour_kind adds kind (skill/template/preset, NOT VALID then VALIDATE), settings JSONB and scope_id to agent_skills, swaps the unique index to (org_id, kind, scope, scope_id, owner_user_id, name), and replaces the digest function without changing existing digests. Proto: ListAgentSkillsRequest.kinds=4 (empty = skills only), AgentSkill kind=21 and settings_json=22. capability-core accepts kind/settings behind AUTHORED_KINDS_ENABLED and lint gains template/preset codes. The composer / menu fills the draft with template text ({{input}} from the rest of the line, never auto-sent) and authored presets list under the curated ones in the run console.
slices.remaining: Waits on D1 (one table with kind: skill/template/preset) and D6 (template = plain text with {{input}}; preset = visible composer defaults; agents stay EP-6), which EP-3 and EP-6 designers must acknowledge. Composer part also waits on the shared slash-command registry from EP-3 S5 FE. [Decisions taken 2026-11-04 at the recommended option (owner).]

slices.title: Export route with JSON and Markdown renderers

One merge line in http_routes.rs and a path block in openapi.yaml. Off: route absent.
